# Photopolymerization_NoC

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method of fabricating network-on-chip interconnects using photopolymerization-based additive manufacturing to create precise, small-world topology structures. Enables rapid prototyping of custom NoC topologies with high geometric precision, critical for testing small-world network optimizations in TCC.
